title: The Unmaking Spring
text: Clear water rises in a ring of white stones, cold and sweet. The moss around it grows in strange shapes: the shape of whatever drinks there, as it was before it came here. Some of the shapes are not human.

options.label: Let the strangest of you bathe in it, and wash away what is not theirs.

outcomes.text: The water is cold and clean. Whatever was not theirs washes off.
The water is cold, and nothing changes but their mood.

options.label: Fill the flasks and go, before the moss takes your shape.

outcomes.text: It tastes of nothing at all. It is the best water any of you have had.
